story.heading: Meet Priya
story.body: Priya left India to work as a domestic worker in Singapore. Her agency handed her a contract in English — a language she was still learning — and picked the money transfer service she used to send money home. She had no way to check if either was fair. NomadFinance reads her contract in Hindi, checks it against Singapore's labor law, and shows her exactly what each provider really charges to send money to her family — so the choice is hers, not her agency's.
